keys.name: slump
keys.pose: still bent from the failed joins, the cloak heavy on the shoulders, the light lost on the floor
keys.lineOfAction: one deep C bowed forward from the hips: head, shoulders and arms on one heavy arc

keys.name: turn
keys.pose: the head and shoulders turn toward the frame's light after a small sink away from it
keys.lineOfAction: an S: shoulders turned one way, hips the other

keys.name: rise
keys.pose: stands up out of the cloak, which drops as a heap; the body lands and settles, the cloth settles after
keys.lineOfAction: a straight rising line, deliberately plumb for the instant she is upright
keys.changes: overshoot past upright, then settle; the cloak lets go

keys.name: step
keys.pose: one step toward the frame, weight travelling onto the lead foot
keys.lineOfAction: a gentle S through the stepping hip
keys.changes: the passing position of the step, then the foot lands

keys.name: threshold
keys.pose: the pause at the frame's edge on one foot, the other heel lifted
keys.lineOfAction: a plumb line over the planted foot
keys.changes: the heel tap into the shoe: contact, then the body settles

keys.name: through
keys.pose: goes through alone, framed small inside the frame's light
keys.lineOfAction: a small S, the figure drawn to a fraction of its height in the light

human.note: Beat 4 of the film (D99): six keys over 300 frames. The chart lists what each key is; the drawings between them are the pose sheet's breakdowns (v3/poses/s02-the-frame.json).

lag.note: the light follows the drawn layer by 2-4 frames; this chart carries the figure only, the light layer is its own sheet

camera.note: the layout's camera for this beat (v3/layouts/s02-cant-build-frame.json): the pan right ends on the raised frame; not authored in this chart
